items.html: And in this manner it is also in the upper coupling of AVI, for in the first verse of the Shema, which is 'Shema Yisrael' of the night, the aspect of the correction of the vessel of the Yesod of Ima herself is made, by other, higher hands; and after she is made a vessel in the first verse of 'Shema Yisrael, etc.,' behold afterward, in the second verse of Baruch Shem, she prepares the vessel of the Nukva of ZA, through her hands, which she lowers down into her Yesod.
